dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Largely smooth margins with a subtle, localized convex bulge on the right lateral edge relative to the axial midline.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-light slate grey median intensity across the visible dorsal plane, indicating a sub-adult or non-mature adult coloration.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low to moderate density of dark-pixel clusters and linear streaks distributed across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the pigmented grey regions and the lighter baseline skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple sets of parallel linear rake marks visible on both the left and right dorsal quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring appearing as multiple sets of parallel lines (rake marks) across the dorsal surface.
